description: Every 10 years, we are asked to honor our civic duty and respond to the census. In 2020, we are experiencing a census like no other, one which is essential not only to our recovery but to defining our future as a nation, yet the census doesn’t get nearly the attention it merits.
title: Heather Bagnall, Mary Lehman and Mike Rogers: Anne Arundel is on track to lose money in this census — Heather Bagnall - Maryland State Delegate - District 33
